annotations.title: List requests waiting for the owner

description: List the team invitations, payment record shares and webhook endpoints that API keys and connected apps asked for on this account, newest first, with whether the account owner confirmed, declined or has not answered yet, and whether a request expired or the API key or connected app that asked withdrew it. A confirmed record share carries the record link while it still works. Only the account owner's API keys and connected apps can list them. Reading changes nothing.
name: list_pending_access

endpoint_url.description: For a webhook endpoint: its host and a masked path. Null otherwise.

invite_email.description: For a team invite: the address to invite.

kind.description: team_invite: an invitation to the team. record_share: a payment record link. webhook_endpoint: a webhook endpoint that receives status changes.

record_url.description: For a confirmed record share: the payment record link, while the record still has that link. Null otherwise.

status.description: pending: waiting for the account owner. confirmed: the owner approved it and it took effect. declined: the owner refused it. expired: nobody answered within seven days, or a later request for the same transfer with different settings replaced it. withdrawn: the API key or connected app closed its own request, by deleting the webhook endpoint or by giving it a new address, which opens a new request.

uetr.description: For a record share: the transfer's UETR.

title: List requests waiting for the owner
